argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: The argument rests on the distinction between experience kinds and information types, from which it derives a hierarchy of empirical defeasibility.

objections_raised: Thesis proponent might argue that spherical vision resists overriding defeaters.
Thesis proponent might argue that compound perceptually justified beliefs resist testimonial defeaters.
Thesis proponent might argue that tactile confirmation guarantees material existence.
dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Each objection is granted partial force but then shown to fail because the relevant belief remains vulnerable to the other species of defeater or to empirically grounded undermining challenges.

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Phenomenological description, modal possibility, and empirical scientific examples

structural_organization.structure_type: Cumulative case via progressively stronger candidate sources

distinctions_drawn: Simple vs compound perceptually justified beliefs

summary_of_core_decisions: The essay attacks empirical indefeasibility by constructing a graded hierarchy of perceptual resilience, then showing that each putatively conclusive belief source is merely at the bottom of the hierarchy rather than outside it. It uses modality-specific distinctions and defeaters as the primary conceptual machinery.
